shared_elements: frontal anthropomorphic figure occupying the whole surface
carved surrounding/framing bands of signs or motifs
symmetrical composition about a vertical axis
low-relief carving on a tall upright slab
justification: Both show a single frontal anthropomorphic personage centred on a tall upright monument, with an elaborate headdress or crest above the head, a chest-level disc/pectoral ornament, and dense low-relief motif fields filling the surrounding surface in bilateral symmetry. They differ strongly in specificity and manner: A is a finely detailed, articulated seated figure with arms and legs set inside an explicit rectangular niche framed by columns of discrete glyph-like blocks, while B is a massive, blocky, near-abstract head-and-body with only shallow schematic incisions and no framing register or defined limbs.
